name: Should I replace my roof during an exterior renovation or wait?
description: Replace your roof during an exterior renovation if it's old, damaged, or nearing its lifespan to prevent future issues and integrate with other upgrades.

mainEntity.name: Should I replace my roof during an exterior renovation or wait?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether to replace your roof during an exterior renovation depends on its current condition, age, and your long-term goals. If your roof is nearing the end of its lifespan, shows signs of significant wear, or has active leaks, replacing it during the renovation is a proactive choice that can prevent future problems and integrate seamlessly with other upgrades. Waiting could lead to unexpected expenses and potential damage to your home's interior if its condition deteriorates. A professional inspection can help determine the best course of action.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replace your roof during an exterior renovation if it's old, damaged, or nearing its lifespan to prevent future issues and integrate with other upgrades.
